notes: defense.<type>.at_depth: summed DepthScale curves (plus fixed amounts) at each sampled depth for the item's own star rating; max = depth 30, the ceiling. Level (heat) bonuses are separate, in level_tables.
Depth-scale evaluation assumes: SegmentedEntry linear between points; Rarity picks the star's entry; DepthCap reads min(depth, cap); ModifyDamage multiplies; Difficulty at medium (shield health).

modifiers: numbers absent in the dump are Java defaults; value_inferred is the most common explicit number for the same kind and bonus label. weapon_class null under a WeaponClass wrapper = the Java default.
set: a name stem (variant suffix and last word removed) shared by items in at least two slots. line: display name of the recipe tree root.
